title: Click through the decisions view in a browser
description: For the owner, in a browser. The Decisions page of the web view was built and tested over HTTP, but nobody has used it by hand. Walk through it once and note anything that looks wrong or confusing. HEIST-14 is a decided decision you can open; create a throwaway one for choosing and reopening.
why: The decisions view was built and tested over HTTP but never used in a browser.

acceptance.text: List refreshes after a change made from the CLI

todos.text: Run: heist serve, open http://127.0.0.1:4000 and choose the project heistman
Open Decisions in the left menu: the list shows the decisions
In a terminal run: heist ask "Test decision?" --options "A
Back in the browser without reloading: the new decision appears within a few seconds
Switch on the filter for decisions that need a person: only the test decision stays
Open it, choose option A: it shows as decided
Press Reopen: it is open again
Clean up: heist ticket update <key of the test decision> --status cancelled
